Doorway.title: Mu'allaqat
Doorway.name: Awad Shaaban
Doorway.creed: Writing is not merely a talent; it is a responsibility toward the word and toward humankind.
Doorway.dedication: To my father, Awad Shaaban — who taught us that the word is a trust.
Doorway.intro: The Mu'allaqat, the poems, the prose, and the satire.
Doorway.countdown: Entering the Diwan in {n}… (move or click to stay)

Muallaqat.title: The Seven Mu'allaqat
Muallaqat.lede: Seven odes once hung upon the drapes of the Kaaba — here they hang again.
Muallaqat.legend: It is told that the Arabs chose the finest odes, wrote them in gold, and hung them upon the Kaaba, so they were called the Mu'allaqat — the Suspended Ones. Each ode hangs here as an illuminated panel that unfurls as you approach.
